title: Lahore Arts Council First Amendment Ordinance 2003

sections.shortTitle: Lahore Arts Council First Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

LAHORE ARTS COUNCIL
LAHORE ARTS
COUNCIL
(FIRST AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE III OF 2003
An Ordinance to
amend the Lahore Arts Council Ordinance, 2003
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2003]
No. Legis 13-54/2002, dated 14-2-2003.--The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Lahore Arts Council
(First Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

No. Legis 13-54/2002, dated 14-2-2003.--The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information:
2. Amendment in sections 2, 8
and 13 of Ordinance LXIII of 2002.----In the said Ordinance, in sections 2,
8 and 13, the word "Governor" wherever occurring, shall be
substituted by the words "Chief Minister".
